reasons.correctness: UserPreferences gains `@Version private Long version`. The changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` to user_preferences. Build green, hidden acceptance 2/2, existing tests 46/46.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset 2026/09/24-09-2026-add-version-to-user-preferences.sql has the formatted-sql header, changeset id and rollback. It is included last in changelog.xml under a `<!-- September 2026: ... -->` comment. MockitoExtension unit test was added and run.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one entity field, one changeset, one include. It reuses JPA @Version exactly as PartnershipOpportunity does. No new mechanism, no service or DTO churn.
reasons.test_quality: UserPreferencesUnitTest asserts @Version is present on a Long field. It checks that ModelMapper keeps the loaded version on update and that a new entity starts with null version. No stale-version conflict path is exercised; it is mostly a structural check.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the userpreferences files, their dependents and TESTED_BY tests before editing. The changeset exemplar and @Version examples were then found by grep/glob, not by the graph.
